truthLaw: Public features, prices and partner programs are evidence of alternatives and distribution surfaces, not evidence that UberBond has demand, payment or acceptance.

decision.buyer: multi-client fractional CMO, coach or marketing partner serving HVAC, plumbing or electrical businesses and lacking independent cross-system QA
decision.scope: One buyer-authorized lead path across public website/form/call-routing handoff/CRM/follow-up timestamps, up to five synthetic scenarios, reproducible evidence and severity-ranked remediation backlog.
decision.acceptance: Buyer confirms the evidence pack reproduces the tested path and identifies supported failure states or verifies no tested failure; no recovered-revenue promise.
decision.hostileCounterCase: A $197 incumbent diagnostic and inexpensive call tracking may be good enough; home-service CRMs already automate missed-call and estimate follow-up; the partner may resist an independent auditor; delivery may exceed the 180-founder-minute ceiling; a payment provider may reject an externally fulfilled service.
killConditions: No authorized partner accepts the cross-system scope or price hypothesis after a separately authorized bounded test.
The deliverable cannot be completed within 180 founder minutes without private customer data or prohibited actions.
The output merely repeats CallRail, Jobber, Housecall Pro or ServiceTitan reporting instead of proving a cross-system failure.
No lawful payment rail approves the exact offer and founder structure.
Refund, dispute, support and delivery receipts make contribution per founder minute unattractive.

challengers.reason: CyberFunnels lists a closely related Marketing Pipeline Diagnostic for $197; a generic $450 audit lacks a supported differentiation.

Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan and answering-service alternatives already provide call capture, automated response or follow-up. Preserve missed-call failure as one test scenario, not the product.
Current field-service platforms already support quote or unsold-estimate follow-up. Preserve cross-system delivery verification as a test scenario.
More defensible evidence need but a less-qualified near-term distribution path and buyer-authorized sandbox dependency.

distribution.immediateResearchCohort: Existing top-three partner seeds remain owner-review-only; no named-client evidence, white-label willingness, conversation or payment is proven.

strategicChannels.name: SBE
strategicChannels.evidence: Official site says it has helped more than 1,000 HVAC and plumbing companies and publishes partner relationships.
strategicChannels.risk: It already supplies coaching, scorecards and partner solutions, so credibility and channel-conflict friction are high.

strategicChannels.name: Service Nation
strategicChannels.evidence: Official partner program says 30,000+ contractors and 100+ vetted partners.
strategicChannels.risk: Vetted marketplace incumbents make entry slow and evidence-heavy.

paymentReadiness.canonicalPath: verified provider event -> durable inbox -> reconciliation lease -> canonical cleared receipt -> fulfillment plan -> buyer acceptance

facts: Egypt appears in the official bank-payout country list.
Published base platform fee is 5% + $0.50, with +1.5% international, +1.5% PayPal and +0.5% subscription adders where applicable.
Outside-US bank payout fee is 1%; net sales are held 13 days and payouts are created twice monthly; minimum payout is $50.
KYC/KYB and store activation are required.
The provider says externally fulfilled services are typically not approved, so this exact sprint is not an approved rail.
Paddle says it works with software businesses worldwide except its unsupported-country list; Egypt is not listed as unsupported.
Published pay-as-you-go anchor is 5% + $0.50 per transaction.
Exact supplier and product eligibility remain unproven for an externally fulfilled evidence service.
Egypt is not shown as a standard Stripe Payments account country.
Stripe Global Payouts recipient availability is not permission for an Egypt-based seller to open a Stripe Payments merchant account.

providerCostLadder: browser only for necessary rendered evidence
licensed provider only after current lower-tier exhaustion receipt
lawful inference with explicit confidence and no private contact generation

softwareDecision.reason: UberBond already has public-evidence tiering, provider-gated enrichment, browser/runtime primitives, payment evidence/reconciliation and fulfillment planning. No repeated paid demand justifies another adapter or offer executor, and PRs 227-231 already claim the current runtime gaps.
